Hi Alicia — please find our completed questionnaire attached and answers inline. I've summarized the technical details below and included two small attachments: a SCIM mapping example and exported admin-audit sample that shows retention and role-change entries.

Summary (high level) — answers to the items called out in your mail: 
1) SSO (SAML / OIDC)
- Supported flows: SAML 2.0 (SP-initiated, IdP-initiated), OIDC Authorization Code flow and ID Token validation.
- Assertion attributes: we commonly map NameID/email (urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress) + givenName, familyName, groups. Example mappings attached in questionnaire tab 'SSO-Mapping'.
- Metadata: we can provide SP metadata XML and support dynamic IdP metadata endpoints.

2) SCIM provisioning
- Protocol: SCIM 2.0 (RFC7644) over TLS 1.2+.
- Sync model: push provisioning from IdP to Redwood using SCIM delta updates (incremental). Full reconciliation supported on demand.
- Failure handling: per-resource HTTP 207 multi-status for batch operations; we return SCIM error objects with standard scimType and detail fields. Transient errors are retried with exponential backoff; persistent failures raise an alert to the tenant's org admins.
- Rate limits: tenant-level throttle (configurable on Dedicated/Private). Default hosted throttle: 1200 requests/minute.
- Sample mapping: see 'redwood_scim_mapping.csv' attached (user, externalId, emails[], active, groups[]).

3) RBAC and admin controls
- Model: role-based with customizable roles, role templates, and resource scoping (organization, project, model).
- Inheritance: roles can be composed (role A includes permissions of role B) but we recommend explicit least-privilege role creation for auditability.
- Example: read-only admin role = view:projects, view:models, list:logs, no token-creation or user-management permissions.
- API & UI: role management via Console and Admin API; all role-change events are recorded in the Audit Log with before/after diffs.

4) Audit & retention
- Audit logs: include actor, timestamp, IP, action, resource, outcome. Logs are exportable via Console (CSV/JSON) and via API (paginated).
- Retention: hosted default retention = 365 days; optional extended retention (3+ years) available as add-on. Private deployments: retention configurable per contract.

Attachments:
- Completed questionnaire: Orion_RFP_IAM_Questionnaire.xlsx (tabbed answers, evidence screenshots embedded).
- SCIM mapping example: redwood_scim_mapping.csv (columns show attribute mapping and sample values).
- Admin audit exported sample (embedded in questionnaire workbook).

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute technical call to walk through the SCIM flow and show the Console provisioning UI. Happy to set that up with Rishi/Monica.

Best,
Soojin Lee

Hi Alicia — quick answers to your clarifications below. Copying Soojin & Monica.

1) SCIM partial failure alerts: we send tenant alerts to the Org Admin email by default. Additionally, for Hosted/Dedicated customers we support configurable Ops hooks: webhook (JSON payload), Syslog, and CloudWatch/EventBridge integrations. We'll include a sample webhook payload schema in the vendor packet.

2) Audit export ordering & pagination: the audit API uses a stable cursor-based pagination token that preserves event ordering (monotonic event sequence number). Exports via Console use the same backend and guarantee ordered paging for rehydration.

If you'd like an example webhook payload and a short sample call, I can attach them to the HubSpot ticket.

Thanks,
